exact_statement: For k >= 3, let F_k(n) be the minimum number of colours needed to colour an n-vertex graph with floor(n^2/4)+1 edges so that every C_(2k+1) is rainbow. For k=3, prove or refute that F_3(n) is asymptotic to n^2/8.
